prompt:
A desktop landing page for 3D Hologram Ads, a business that sells holographic LED fan displays to small shops and bars, rendered edge to edge with crisp readable text, no browser window or device around it. The visitor is a liquor-store or café owner deciding whether to buy; the page must make them stop and request a quote.

The page is built on a painted fairground attraction banner and a theatre marquee. Across the top, a brass marquee strip studded with small warm tungsten bulbs carries the name 3D HOLOGRAM ADS and the navigation links: How it works, In the wild, The kit, Prices, Get a quote. Below it the banner fills the screen: deep vermilion painted canvas. On the left, the headline SEE IT FLOAT in heavy outlined 1940s showcard lettering with a cream fill and cobalt drop shadow, then one plain line: A holographic LED fan that spins your logo in mid-air, plus the 3D content made for it. On the right, a bulb-framed attraction window, pure black inside, where a glowing 3D liquor bottle rotates in mid-air with no screen behind it. Under the window a painted cream ADMISSION board with three tick-box lines: Fan + cover $250, Content $150, Tripod $99, and a ticket-booth button reading Request a quote · $400. At the bottom edge the next painted panel begins: a photo of the fan running on a shelf in a real wine aisle, with the placard No. 1 · IN THE WILD.

Every highlight on the page is warm tungsten light from the marquee bulbs; colour glows only inside the black attraction window. Painted canvas texture, enamel lettering, brass. Not a poster: a working web page with legible links, text, tick boxes and a button.
